description: This file defines API routes related to analysis operations, such as fetching analysis status and results, acknowledging suggestions, canceling analyses, and retrieving analyses for a user. It utilizes FastAPI framework components and interacts with multiple repository classes to perform data retrieval and updates.

methods.name: get_analysis_status(analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"))
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a specific analysis by its ID.

methods.name: get_analysis_results(analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"))
methods.description: Retrieves the full results of a completed analysis, including findings and suggestions.

methods.name: acknowledge_suggestion(analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"), suggestion_id: int = Body(..., embed=True))
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a suggestion related to an analysis, currently a placeholder with no operation.

methods.name: cancel_analysis(analysis_id: int = Path(..., alias="id"))
methods.description: Updates the status of an ongoing analysis to 'cancelled'.

methods.name: get_user_analyses(user_id: int = Path(..., alias="userId"))
methods.description: Retrieves all analyses associated with a specified user ID.
